description: Synthetic QA cases for the Review Writing AI feedback Worker. Expected behaviours are qualitative, not exact marks. Use only after inspecting the actual Worker implementation.

cases.task: Write a restaurant review for students choosing somewhere to eat, 120–160 words.
cases.response: I visited the restaurant last weekend. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. I really enjoyed my meal. I would recommend it to everyone.

expect.groundedQuote: The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive.
expect.focus: Explain the attentive service through a real example, if the student can supply one
mustNot: Claim details about food or staff that are not in the draft

cases.task: Write a review of a film for your school magazine.
cases.response: The story was exciting, but the actors was not convincing. The ending was surprising.

cases.task: Review a book for younger teenagers and explain whether you recommend it.
cases.response: The book had interesting characters and fast-moving action. I liked the ending because the central problem was solved in a surprising way.

expect.focus: Recommendation is missing, and the review should specify the target reader
mustNot: Invent a recommendation that the writer has not given

cases.task: Review a café for visitors to your city.
cases.response: The small café is worth visiting for its relaxed atmosphere and excellent coffee. Although the tables are tightly packed, the friendly staff make customers feel welcome. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a quiet afternoon break, especially on weekdays when it is less crowded.

expect.focus: Only justified refinements; accurate language must not be called incorrect

cases.task: Review a school theatre performance for the school website.
cases.response: The actors made the main characters believable. However, the music was sometimes too loud, which made the dialogue difficult to follow. Overall, I would recommend the performance to younger students because it was funny and easy to understand.
The café was pleasant and the food arrived quickly.

mockModelItem.suggestion: The staff answered our questions politely.

expect.reason: Model quotation is absent from submitted draft
